work.title: Export a report to a spreadsheet
work.for: Customers using the invoicing software, help article for the support manager to review
body: Check against the current screen: menu names, report names and button positions below are placeholders for the support manager to confirm before publishing.
You can export any report to a spreadsheet file to share it or work with the numbers yourself.

To export a report: open {Reports menu name} from the main menu. Choose the report you want, such as {a common report}. Set the date range and any filters, then select {Apply button name}. Select {Export button and its position} and choose the spreadsheet option. The file downloads to your computer.
If the export button is greyed out, run the report first. {Confirm that export needs a report with results.}
If the file opens with all the data in one column, open your spreadsheet program first and use its import option, choosing comma as the separator.
If some invoices are missing, check the date range and filters. The export includes only what the report shows on screen.
Still stuck? Contact support from the Help menu and tell us which report you were exporting.
